verdict.rationale: Brex's Bill Pay product page covers each element of the story. Brex AI captures itemized invoice details, suggests the matching PO and drafts a payment. Multi-level approval flows route automatically by amount, vendor and role. Vendors can be paid by ACH, check, wire or virtual card, with vendor onboarding and a vendor-creation API as supporting evidence. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-depth documentation of invoice intake channels and payment rails beyond marketing copy.
